_doc: The memory map (words; addresses are 15-bit). ROM 0..rom_size-1 holds the lib; RAM starts at rom_size (= data_base: globals, then strings at +256, code at code_base, the staged-data count at init-1, staging at init, the stack from sp0 up); the console is the last cols*rows words of RAM. Read by cc_ref.py (LAYOUT), libbuild.js, uarch.py and the page generator.
